tickerText: [TENNIS] WTA's one-time SRY gene screening takes effect today as Tsitsipas ends a 16-month drought with the Gstaad title • [SQUASH] World Squash Junior Championships roll on in Niagara-on-the-Lake with 185 U-19 players competing through July 31 • [BADMINTON] VICTOR China Open Super 1000 opens in Changzhou as Sindhu and Lakshya Sen lead India's first-round charge • [PICKLEBALL] Collin Johns and Len Yang headline the PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open from July 23–26 with a $79,000 purse at Sports Arina • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos qualifying begins in Brazil as Kanak Jha and Lily Zhang chase 600 ranking points

newsItems.title: WTA Gene Screening Policy Takes Effect
newsItems.excerpt: The WTA's updated eligibility policy begins today, requiring a one-time SRY gene test for all players competing on the women's tour ahead of the 2028 Olympics.

newsItems.title: World Squash Junior Championships Underway
newsItems.excerpt: Niagara-on-the-Lake hosts 185 U-19 players at White Oaks and Ridley College for individual play through July 25, with team competition to follow.

newsItems.title: China Open Super 1000 Opens in Changzhou
newsItems.excerpt: The $2 million VICTOR China Open begins today at Changzhou's Olympic Sports Center, with PV Sindhu facing Unnati Hooda in an all-India women's singles opener.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open Set for Debut
newsItems.excerpt: Collin Johns, Len Yang and Long Yufei headline the inaugural PPA Asia 500 at Sports Arina from July 23–26, Singapore's highest-tier pro pickleball event.
